findings.current: Baek Yeon and the man in black.
findings.defect: “Man” assigns a male identity to the black-clad master, whom this account identifies as So Gyo.
findings.rationale: 흑의인 identifies the person by clothing, not gender.
findings.replacement: Baek Yeon and the figure in black.

findings.current: The only reason we lost was that man in black… No, that unidentified master I should now call So Gyo.
findings.defect: Again assigns a male identity to the person Ma Sanbao now calls So Gyo.
findings.rationale: 흑의인 remains gender-neutral here; the correction concerns what to call the master.
findings.replacement: The only reason we lost was that figure in black… No, that unidentified master I should now call So Gyo.
findings.source: 유일한 패인(敗因)은 바로 그 흑의인…… 아니, 이제는 소교라고 불러야 할 정체불명의 고수였지.

findings.current: So Gyo was a master for whom even *a match for ten thousand men* seemed an inadequate description.
findings.defect: Reverses the judgment: the source says the description would not be inadequate, not that it falls short.
findings.rationale: 부족하지 않을 만한 explicitly affirms that the description fits.
findings.replacement: So Gyo, too, was a master who could rightly be called *a match for ten thousand men*.
findings.source: 소교 역시 만부부당(萬夫不當)이라는 표현이 부족하지 않을 만한 고수였다.

findings.current: It wasn’t hard to guess that if his one and only Disciple risked going to the imperial palace, his Master would come along.
findings.defect: After the preceding mention of Hong Jin, “his” can make Jin sound like Hong Jin’s Disciple rather than Jeok Cheongang’s.
findings.rationale: The Disciple is Jin Taekyung, and the Master Ma expected to follow him is Jeok Cheongang.
findings.replacement: It wasn’t hard to guess that if you, Jeok Cheongang’s only Disciple, risked going to the imperial palace, your Master would come along.
findings.source: 하나뿐인 제자가 위험을 무릅쓰고 황궁으로 향한다면, 그 스승 역시 함께하리라는 것은 어렵지 않게 예상할 수 있었으니까.

findings.current: “It was more than ten years ago. That was when So Gyo—or rather, the unidentified master—first appeared.”
findings.defect: The draft jumps straight to the scene break, omitting Ma Sanbao’s voice carrying through rain that has begun to ease.
findings.rationale: The transition marks the rain’s gradual change before the account ends.
findings.replacement:
“It was more than ten years ago. That was when So Gyo—or rather, the unidentified master—first appeared.”

As the rain slowly began to ease, his voice filtered through it.
findings.source: 서서히 잦아들기 시작한 빗소리 너머로, 그의 목소리가 스며들었다.

findings.current: The Chief Eunuch wouldn’t be bedridden as he is now, either.
findings.defect: Replaces the established name Cang Gong with a generic title.
findings.rationale: 창공 is mapped to Cang Gong in the packet’s binding glossary.
findings.replacement: Cang Gong wouldn’t be bedridden as he is now, either.
findings.source: 창공(廠公)께서 지금처럼 병석에 누워 계실 일도 없었겠지.

findings.current: If Ma Sanbao’s story was true, then the Chief Eunuch, now fallen to illness, had been a remarkable man.
findings.defect: Replaces Cang Gong’s name with a generic title.
findings.rationale: The narration names 창공, not merely his office.
findings.replacement: If Ma Sanbao’s story was true, then Cang Gong, now fallen to illness, had been a remarkable man.
findings.source: 지금은 병마를 이기지 못해 쓰러진 창공은 대단한 걸물이었다.

findings.current: Chief Eunuch was the first to sense something was wrong.
findings.defect: Drops both Cang Gong’s established name and Ma Sanbao’s respectful form of reference.
findings.rationale: 창공 어른 names Cang Gong while expressing respect.
findings.replacement: Lord Cang Gong was the first to sense something was wrong.
findings.source: 가장 먼저 낌새를 알아차린 것도 창공 어른이셨지.

findings.current: At the time, Ma Sanbao had also served under Chief Eunuch.
findings.defect: Replaces Cang Gong’s name with a generic title.
findings.rationale: 창공 is the named person Ma Sanbao served under.
findings.replacement: At the time, Ma Sanbao had also served under Cang Gong.
findings.source: 당시의 마삼보 역시 창공의 휘하에 있었고

findings.current: The life-and-death duel between Baek Yeon and Chief Eunuch was evenly matched.
findings.defect: Drops Cang Gong’s name and Ma Sanbao’s respectful address.
findings.rationale: 창공 어른 identifies and respectfully refers to the East Depot leader.
findings.replacement: The life-and-death duel between Baek Yeon and Lord Cang Gong was evenly matched.
findings.source: 백연과 창공 어른 간의 생사결은 백중세(伯仲勢)였네.

findings.current: Chief Eunuch couldn’t withstand the combined assault of the two Supreme Peak masters.
findings.defect: Replaces the named combatant Cang Gong with a generic title.
findings.rationale: The source identifies the fallen combatant as 창공.
findings.replacement: Cang Gong couldn’t withstand the combined assault of the two Supreme Peak masters.
findings.source: 두 초절정 고수의 합공을 이기지 못한 창공은 극심한 내상과 함께 쓰러졌고

findings.current: Chief Eunuch once called him one of the few true chivalrous heroes left in this age.
findings.defect: Replaces Cang Gong’s name with a generic title.
findings.rationale: Ma Sanbao attributes the assessment specifically to 창공.
findings.replacement: Cang Gong once called him one of the few true chivalrous heroes left in this age.
findings.source: 창공께서는 그를 가리켜 이 시대에 몇 안 남은 진정한 협객이라고도 하셨고.

findings.current: You must be from the north. You certainly know how to drink.
findings.defect: Turns Ma Sanbao’s explanation for Jin’s hearty drinking into a guess about where Jin is from.
findings.rationale: 북방이 고향이라 그런지 treats Jin’s northern home as given and speculates about its effect on his drinking.
findings.replacement: Maybe it’s because you’re from the north, but you certainly drink with gusto.

findings.current: The remaining liquor spilled out in a rush.
findings.defect: Omits that the flask was still half full.
findings.rationale: 반쯤 남았던 specifies how much liquor remained when it fell.
findings.replacement: The flask was still half full, and the liquor spilled out in a rush.

summary: The draft is largely faithful, but it assigns a male identity to the black-clad master, reverses a comparison of So Gyo’s strength, obscures whose Disciple Jin is, omits a rain transition, and replaces Cang Gong’s established name throughout.
